input_grammar: Exact built-in dictionary F,real,imag with exact int and list types; state exact N,B,a,beta
input_provenance: Separately supplied original caller context; no authentication of an unknown external source
trust_model: Correct trusted Python/stdlib/code; no concurrent input mutation, hostile reflection or module monkeypatching
root_contract: Exact outward interval enclosure of intended exp(pi*i*r/N), squared endpoint-distance check <=2^(-2p)
rounding_contract: Nearest grid, signed ties-to-even; exact sums/products before each specified rounding
stored_range: Every main Cartesian grid integer magnitude <2^(p+I), I=B+2ceil(log2 N)+10
product_range: Exact Cartesian product accumulators fit accepted 2(p+I)+4 signed-bit allowance
adapter: Actual reviewed pinned legacy adapt on actual immutable produced payload
adapter_domain: Dyadic N>=4 within local producer domain, plus unchanged legacy actual-width and metadata checks
generic_q: q>=ceil(log2 N); actual adapter target-budget comparison still required
semantic_verification: Whole fresh recomputation and exact canonical payload/context/policy equality; no receipt attestation trusted
resource_failure: Explicit failure without numerical success certificate; no claim of total host resource availability
cost_model: Cumulative conservative schoolbook bit work and cumulative logical storage; not machine-word runtime, Python RSS or practical speed
numerical_completion_scope: Bounded live producer binding and compatible adapter, pending independent review
full_theorem_remaining_deployment_depend: Valid downstream theorem instance retaining all original guards
